
## CROSS SECTIONAL ANALYSIS OF MUSLIM ACCEPTANCE 2016 (T8) ##
library(dplyr)

system.time(
   dat.long <- as.data.frame(read.table("/Users/Ben/Documents/Ben_Data/NZAVSLongitudinalSPSS_ BaseDataset.csv",
  header=TRUE,
  sep=",",
  na = -9999)))

dat.long<- as.data.frame(dat.long)

longi8<- dat.long%>%
  filter(T08==1)


nrow(longi8)#21936


#### Data Shaping ####
dat.MA <- longi8

### Add ID Variable ###
dat.MA$Id <- factor(1:nrow(longi8))

### Census as factor ###
dat.MA$Census.Religion.L3.T8 <- as.factor(dat.MA$Census.Religion.L3.T8)
table(dat.MA$Census.Religion.L3.T8)





 #### T8 Data Selection ####
 dat.MA.S<-dat.MA%>%
   dplyr::select(Id,
          EthnicCats.T8,
          Age.T8,
          Gender.T8,
          NZDep_2013.T08,
          NZREG.T8,
          Partner.T8,
          Religious.T8,
          Religion.Church.T8,
          Census.Religion.L2.T8,
          Census.Religion.L3.T8,
          Census.Religion.L1.T8,
          Religion.Identification.T8,
          UrbanT8,
          PolOrient.T8,
          T8.ETH.Warm.Immigrants,
          T8.ETH.Warm.Arabs,
          T8.ETH.Warm.Muslims,
          T8.Perc.Religious.Discrim,
          T8.RELIGIOUS.ATTS,
          EthL2.Euro.T8,
          Employment.T8,
          EthL3.AsianOther.T8,
          EthL2.Asian.T8,
          EthL3.MiddleEastern.T8,
          T8.RWA,
          T8.SDO,
          BornNZ.T8)%>%
   mutate(Religion.Church.T8 = ifelse(Religious.T8 == 0| Religion.Church.T8=="NA", 0, Religion.Church.T8))%>%
   mutate(Pol.Orient.T8 = as.numeric(PolOrient.T8))%>%
   mutate(Employed.T8 = as.factor(Employment.T8))%>%
   mutate(EthnicCats.T8 = as.factor(EthnicCats.T8))%>%
   mutate(Urban.T8 = as.factor(UrbanT8))%>%
   mutate(EthL3.MiddleEastern.T8 = as.factor(EthL3.MiddleEastern.T8))%>%
   mutate(Census.Religion.L3.T8 = as.factor(Census.Religion.L3.T8))%>%
  dplyr::select(-c(UrbanT8, 
             PolOrient.T8, 
             Employment.T8))
 
 ### Making Relid and BigDoms Variables ###
 dat.MA.S.1 <-dat.MA.S%>%
   mutate(Relid.T8 = ifelse(Religious.T8 == 0, 0, Religion.Identification.T8))%>%
   mutate(Census.Religion.L1.T8=as.factor(Census.Religion.L1.T8))%>%
   mutate(AAReligious.T8 = as.factor(ifelse(Census.Religion.L3.T8 ==0, 1, 0)))%>%
   mutate(Christian.T8 = as.factor(ifelse(Census.Religion.L1.T8 == 2| Census.Religion.L1.T8 == 6,1,0)))%>%
   mutate(Christian_nfd.T8 =as.factor(ifelse(Census.Religion.L3.T8 == 20000, 1,0)))%>%
   mutate(Catholic.T8 = as.factor(ifelse(Census.Religion.L3.T8 == 20600|Census.Religion.L3.T8 ==  20601| Census.Religion.L3.T8 ==  20699, 1,0)))%>%
   mutate(Anglican.T8 = as.factor(ifelse(Census.Religion.L3.T8 == 20201, 1,0)))%>%
   mutate(PresbyCongReform.T8 = as.factor(ifelse(Census.Religion.L3.T8 == 21501 |Census.Religion.L3.T8 ==21502 |Census.Religion.L3.T8==21505, 1,0)))%>%
   mutate(Pentecostals.T8 = as.factor(ifelse(Census.Religion.L3.T8 == 21400 |Census.Religion.L3.T8 == 21401| Census.Religion.L3.T8== 21402| Census.Religion.L3.T8 == 21403 |Census.Religion.L3.T8 == 21404 |Census.Religion.L3.T8== 21405| Census.Religion.L3.T8 == 21406 |Census.Religion.L3.T8 == 21408| Census.Religion.L3.T8== 21409 | Census.Religion.L3.T8 == 21410 |Census.Religion.L3.T8 == 21411 |Census.Religion.L3.T8==21412 |Census.Religion.L3.T8== 21499, 1,0)))%>%
   mutate(Muslim.T8 = as.factor(ifelse(Census.Religion.L3.T8 == 40100|Census.Religion.L3.T8 ==40199|Census.Religion.L3.T8 ==40101, 1,0)))
  
 dat.MA.S.1$BigDoms.T8 <- factor(ifelse(dat.MA.S.1$AAReligious.T8==1, "AAReligious",
                                          ifelse(dat.MA.S.1$Anglican.T8==1, "Anglican",
                                                 ifelse(dat.MA.S.1$Catholic.T8==1, "Catholic",
                                                        ifelse(dat.MA.S.1$PresbyCongReform.T8==1,"PresbyCongReform",
                                                               ifelse(dat.MA.S.1$Christian_nfd.T8==1,"Christian_nfd","TheOthers"))))))

   #### Amelia Imputation Denominations ####
   library(Amelia)
   
   # Remove what we do not need anymore
   dat.MA.aprep <-dat.MA.F %>% 
     dplyr::select(-c(EthL3.MiddleEastern.T8, 
               EthL3.AsianOther.T8,
               EthL2.Asian.T8, 
               Muslim.T8, 
               Pentecostals.T8, 
               Religion.Identification.T8,
               AAReligious.T8, 
               Christian.T8, 
               Christian_nfd.T8, 
               Catholic.T8, 
               Anglican.T8, 
               PresbyCongReform.T8,
               EthL2.Euro.T8, BornNZ.T8))
   
   head(dat.MA.aprep)
   
   #missmap(dat.MA.aprep)
   
   dat.MA.Imputed <- amelia(
     dat.MA.aprep, #dataset to impute
     m = 5, # number of imputations 
     #cs=NULL,
     #ts=NULL,
     noms = c("Gender.T8",
              "Urban.T8",
              "Partner.T8",
              "EthnicCats.T8",
              "Employed.T8",
              "BigDoms.T8"),
     ords=c("NZDep_2013.T08",
            "NZREG.T8"),
     logs=c("Religion.Church.T8"),
     idvars=c("Id","Census.Religion.L3.T8", "Census.Religion.L2.T8", "Census.Religion.L1.T8", 
              "T8.ETH.Warm.Immigrants", "T8.ETH.Warm.Arabs", "T8.ETH.Warm.Muslims"))
   
   head(dat.MA.Imputed)
   
   
   ### Amelia Transformations ###
   dat.MA.Imputed.1 <- transform.amelia(dat.MA.Imputed,
                                Age.10yrs.T8 = (Age.T8/10),
                                Pol.Orient.T8.S =scale(Pol.Orient.T8, center=TRUE,scale=TRUE),
                                Male.T8 = factor(Gender.T8),
                                Employed.T8 = factor(Employed.T8),
                                NZREG.T8.C = scale(NZREG.T8 ,scale=TRUE,center=TRUE),
                                Urban.T8 = factor(Urban.T8),
                                #EthL2.Euro.T8 = factor(EthL2.Euro.T8),
                                EthnicCats.T8 = factor(EthnicCats.T8),
                                NZDep.T8.S = scale(NZDep_2013.T08, scale=TRUE, center=TRUE),
                                Relid.T8.S = scale(Relid.T8, scale =TRUE,center=TRUE),
                                Religion.Church.T8.Log = log(Religion.Church.T8 +1),
                                T8.RELIGIOUS.ATTS.S = scale(T8.RELIGIOUS.ATTS, scale=TRUE, center = TRUE),
                                T8.Perc.Religious.Discrim.S = scale(T8.Perc.Religious.Discrim, scale= TRUE, center = TRUE),
                                Id =as.factor(Id),
                                T8.SDO.S = scale(T8.SDO, scale = TRUE, center = TRUE),
                                T8.RWA.S = scale(T8.RWA, scale = TRUE, center = TRUE))
   
   
   dat.MA.Imputed.2 <- transform.amelia(dat.MA.Imputed.1,
                                Age.10yrs.T8.C = scale(Age.10yrs.T8,scale =FALSE, center=TRUE),
                                Religion.Church.T8.Log.S = scale(Religion.Church.T8.Log))  # now to center age, having put the units on a sensible scale above
   
   
   ### Making List ### 
   
   dat.MA.Imputed.list <- list(dat.MA.Imputed.2$imputations$imp1, dat.MA.Imputed.2$imputations$imp2, dat.MA.Imputed.2$imputations$imp3,

   #### Amelia-Imputed Census Random Effects Models ####
   library(merTools)
   library(lme4)
   library(coefplot)

   ### Census Models, Tables, and Plots ###
   
   ## Muslim Warmth Table and Plot ##   
  WM.ModList <- lmerModList(T8.ETH.Warm.Muslims ~ 
                              Age.10yrs.T8.C +
                              Employed.T8 +
                              EthnicCats.T8 +
                              Male.T8 +
                              NZDep.T8.S +
                              NZREG.T8.C +
                              Partner.T8 +
                              Pol.Orient.T8.S +
                              T8.RWA.S +
                              T8.SDO.S +
                              Relid.T8.S +
                              Religion.Church.T8.Log +
                              T8.RELIGIOUS.ATTS.S +
                              Urban.T8 +
                                  (1|Census.Religion.L3.T8), data=dat.MA.Imputed.list)
  

modelFixedEff(WM.ModList) ### Table
print(WM.ModList)
WM.ModList.1<-modelFixedEff(WM.ModList)


WM.ModList.2 <- WM.ModList.1%>%
  mutate(Coefficient = term,
         LowOuter = estimate -(2*std.error), # Two standard deviations in negative direction
         HighOuter = estimate +(2*std.error), # Two standard deviations in positive direction
         Model = rep("model1", nrow(WM.ModList.1)),
         Value = estimate,
         LowInner = estimate -std.error, #One standard deviations in negative direction
         HighInner = estimate + std.error) # One standard deviations in positive direction

coefplot.data.frame(WM.ModList.2, title = "Muslim Warmth", pointSize = 3, color = "blue") ### Plot

   ### Big Doms Models ###
   
   ### Filter to Only CHristians ###
   dat.MA.BD <- dat.MA.F%>%
     filter(Christian.T8 ==1)
   
   
   ### Center and Scale Data ###
   dat.MA.BD.S <- dat.MA.BD%>%
     mutate(Age.10yrs.T8 = (Age.T8/10))%>%
     mutate(Age.10yrs.T8.C = scale(Age.10yrs.T8, center=TRUE,scale=FALSE),
            Pol.Orient.T8.S =scale(Pol.Orient.T8, center=FALSE,scale=TRUE),
            Male.T8 = factor(Gender.T8),
            Employed.T8 = factor(Employed.T8),
            Partner.T8 = factor(Partner.T8),
            NZREG.T8.C = scale(NZREG.T8 ,scale=F,center=T),
            Urban.T8 = factor(Urban.T8),
            EthL2.Euro.T8 = factor(EthL2.Euro.T8),
            EthnicCats.T8 = factor(EthnicCats.T8),
            NZDep.T8.S = scale(NZDep_2013.T08, scale=TRUE, center=FALSE),
            Relid.T8.S = scale(Relid.T8, scale =T,center=F),
            Religion.Church.T8.Log = log(Religion.Church.T8 +1),
            T8.RELIGIOUS.ATTS.S = scale(T8.RELIGIOUS.ATTS),
            T8.Perc.Religious.Discrim.S = scale(T8.Perc.Religious.Discrim),
            BigDoms.T8 = factor(BigDoms.T8),
            Id =as.factor(Id))
   
   
   ### Models ###
   mod.3<-glmmTMB(T8.ETH.Warm.Muslims ~ 
               BigDoms.T8 +
               Age.10yrs.T8.C +
               Male.T8 +
               NZREG.T8.C +
               Relid.T8.S +
               Religion.Church.T8.Log +
               NZDep.T8.S +
               Employed.T8 +
                Partner.T8 +
               T8.Perc.Religious.Discrim.S +
        #       EthnicCats.T8 +
               EthL2.Euro.T8 +
               T8.RELIGIOUS.ATTS.S +
               Urban.T8 + 
               Pol.Orient.T8.S +
               (1|Census.Religion.L3.T8),
              family = "gaussian",
              data= dat.MA.BD.S, na.action = na.omit)
   
   summary(mod.3)
   tab_model(mod.3)
   plot_model(mod.3)  
   
   
   ### Predicted Probability Models ###
   
   m3 <- ggpredict(mod.3, c("Relid.T8.C","Big_Denominations"))

   plot(m3, facet=T)
   m3 <- ggpredict(mod.3, c("T8.Perc.Religious.Discrim.S","Big_Denominations"))
   plot(m3, facet=T)
